headline: DO: the 355 Comanche counter went out and the seller acknowledged it — Monday's only question is what the buyers say back. · WATCH: the buyer's agent is bringing an HVAC contractor to your seller's Lake Crest house at 10:30 tomorrow, and he should hear that from you first.

notes: THE SAME-DAY VERIFIER WENT DARK AFTER LUNCH ON THE ONE DAY WITH A CLOCK. The 12:15 Delta logged 'IN-PROGRESS — expect MATERIAL' at 1:15 PM and never finished: no email in Gmail, no completion line. The 3:15 and 6:15 passes never ran at all. Today's letter explicitly promised re-verification at 12:15 / 3:15 / 6:15 against a 7:00 PM offer deadline — and the last three of those never happened.

EVERYTHING ELSE RAN CLEAN, and that is the real shape of the day: zero BLOCKED lines in 24 hours, four milestone-engine passes, inbox triage, the ISA sweep, both morning console refreshes, the marketing and engagement sweeps, and the ISA Daily at 7:00 PM (Sunday no-touch honored absolutely — 0 sends across 9 sweep passes).

The 17-hour outage (7/25 3:38 PM → 7/26 8:55 AM) still sits inside this 24-hour window. It cost Saturday's Deep Dive, Saturday's Money Pulse and both weekend letters. Third time this month; the reliability build has now earned itself four times over.

callBlock.why: 🔴 THE BUYER SIDE IS BRINGING AN HVAC COMPANY TO YOUR SELLER'S HOUSE AT 10:30 MONDAY, AND HE DOESN'T KNOW.
